$comment: Nigerian Pidgin urgent messages. DRAFT translation derived from en.json; needs native-speaker review and clinical adviser approval. Phone numbers and hrefs are byte-identical to en.json.

emergency.title: Dis one fit be emergency
body: Wetin you describe fit be serious.
No wait to see whether e go better.
Dis app no fit check symptoms or give medical advice.
emergency.banner: You tell us something wey fit be emergency. If you never do am, call 999 now now.
emergency.selfHarmLine: When you don dey safe, Samaritans dey any time, day or night. Call 116 123.

urgent.title: Abeg, find help quick
body: Wetin you describe fit need doctor or nurse to look am quick.
Contact NHS 111 now, for phone or online, or call your GP surgery if dem open.
If e dey worse, or you think say na emergency, call 999.
Dis app no fit check symptoms or give medical advice.
urgent.banner: You tell us something wey fit need help quick. If you never do am, contact NHS 111 or your GP surgery.

crisis.title: You no need to face dis one alone
body: E be like say you dey pass through something wey hard well well now.
You fit talk to Samaritans free, any time, day or night. Call 116 123.
If you dey for danger now now, or you fit act on dis kain thought, call 999 now now.
You fit also call NHS 111 for urgent mental health help.
To talk for your own language, call NHS 111 and ask for interpreter.
crisis.banner: You tell us say you fit dey pass through something wey hard well well. Samaritans dey any time for 116 123. If you dey for danger now now, call 999.

continueCheck.link: I no dey for danger, I wan continue
continueCheck.title: Before you continue
body: Only continue if you no dey for danger now now.
Samaritans dey any time, day or night. Call 116 123.
continueCheck.confirm: I no dey for danger now now
